answer: Require every identity, once per epoch, to defend one of its own past submissions live before a rotating panel of skeptics who probe the reasoning with fresh objections. A canned reply cannot track a new objection, so a farm operator must attend each clone's hearing personally: fifty hearings, fifty separate minds. Each defense sends a ripple through the panel's scores, and an island of clones answering in one voice is exposed at once. The umber transcript, published verbatim, lets any peer re-score a defense later, so buying one good hearing buys nothing for the next.
